:::{#def-new-data-point}
#### New data point

A **new data point** is an [input](#def-input) and [outcome](#def-outcome) pair $(\Predvar, \Outvar)$ with the same joint distribution as the data used to choose the prediction, whose input is observed and whose outcome is not yet observed.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-new-data-point}
#### A new data point in the best-predictor exercise

In @exr-best-predictor, a new data point has input $\Predvar = 1$ and an outcome that is $4$ or $6$ with equal probability.
A [prediction](#def-prediction) of $5$ is a guess for that unobserved outcome.

:::
